newsitem.title: USA: Amer Residential names Nicodemus CFO.
newsitem.headline: Amer Residential names Nicodemus CFO.

text.p: American Residential Services, Inc Tuesday said Harry Nicodemus IV will join its management team as vice president, chief financial officer and chief accounting officer.
American Residential is a provider of residential maintenance, repair and installation services.
For the past year, Nicodemus served as corporate controller for Drilex International Inc Inc, an oilfield services company.
William McCaughey retired as chief financial officer but will remain on the company's board of directors, the company said.
